title: Intake re-check: duplicates and failures that stopped reproducing close with evidence

story.i_want_to: recognise an issue that duplicates live work, or whose failing tests have passed on base since it was reported
story.so_that: neither costs a triage dispatch, and the reporter is told why with the proof

rationale: PRD R6 names three re-check outcomes; US-52.36 built the step and already_fixed. Duplicates today are found, if at all, by the triage trio reading prose (triage@1's 'not actionable ... duplicates another report' text, resolution.ex:72), after a dispatch is spent; chg's own findings already name the failing tests (Findings failure_names, findings.ex:514) and its gate rows record full-suite verdicts per base sha (chg_ledger_rows, ledger_row.ex:21-32), so both checks can be made from loopctl's records before triage. This story adds those two findings to IntakeRecheck; it adds no table.

acceptance_criteria.description: The finding duplicate holds when another story of the same project, not at done or failed and not this story, has an intake record with the same ticket_id, or a chg finding sharing at least one failure name with this record's finding; the re-check names the other story's id.

A duplicate story moves detected -> failed over the new control-only edge :recheck_duplicate, whose resolution verdict is the new :duplicate (not-actionable label, its own text), with evidence naming the other story's issue number and URL; the older story is never the one closed.

The finding no_longer_reproduces holds when the record's chg finding names failures and, since the issue was opened, the source repo has at least 3 chg_ledger_rows of kind gate, verdict pass and raw source other than hook at shas PullRequestSource.contains?/3 reports in the base branch, and no failing gate row since then lists any of those names.

A no_longer_reproduces story moves detected -> done over the new control-only edge :recheck_stale, whose resolution verdict is the new :no_longer_reproduces (not-actionable label, its own text asking the reporter to report again if it recurs), with evidence listing the passing rows' shas and times.

A record with no chg finding, or a finding with no failure names, yields neither duplicate (by failure) nor no_longer_reproduces; issue text is never compared, so reporter wording cannot make or avoid a match.
When more than one finding holds, the re-check acts on the first in the order already_fixed, duplicate, no_longer_reproduces and records all of them in the 'rechecked' event.

Two stories that duplicate each other, re-checked in the same pass, close at most one: the duplicate check locks both stories' stage rows in story id order and re-reads the other's stage under the lock.

test_cases.name: a newer issue for the same failure closes as a duplicate of the live one (DataCase)
preconditions: project P; story S1 at implementing whose record's finding names test A; new story S2 at detected whose finding names A and B
expected_results: S2 failed over recheck_duplicate; closure verdict duplicate, evidence names S1's issue; S1 unchanged

test_cases.name: terminal or other-project stories are not duplicates (DataCase)
preconditions: a done story and another project's live story both with test A; S2 with test A

test_cases.name: three full-suite passes on base since the report close it as stale (DataCase, PullRequestSourceMock)
preconditions: finding names test A, issue opened at t0; 3 gate pass rows after t0 at shas contains? true; a hook-source pass row; a pass row before t0
expected_results: done over recheck_stale; evidence lists exactly the 3 shas

test_cases.name: a later failure of the named test, or a pass off base, keeps it open (DataCase, PullRequestSourceMock)
preconditions: the same 3 pass rows plus one gate fail row listing A after them; twin with one of the 3 shas contains? false
expected_results: neither is stale; both proceed to triage

test_cases.name: identical issue text without a finding matches nothing (DataCase)
preconditions: two records with the same title and body, no ticket_id, no finding

test_cases.name: precedence when several findings hold (DataCase)
preconditions: a story that is both a duplicate and stale
expected_results: failed over recheck_duplicate; event lists duplicate and no_longer_reproduces

test_cases.name: mutual duplicates close one (DataCase, two connections)
preconditions: two detected stories with the same ticket_id; Loopctl.Test.ProductionTopology
expected_results: exactly one at failed over recheck_duplicate; the older proceeds to triage

technical_notes: IntakeRecheck is provided by US-52.36; this story adds two finders and their edges.

Failure names: Findings.failure_names (lib/loopctl/changes/findings.ex:514) over finding.evidence['failures'] (finding.ex:31-54); the record's finding is Findings.for_record/1 (:584), the other stories' findings via Findings.loop_finding_for/1 (:1363) over stories.intake_record_id (lib/loopctl/work_breakdown/story.ex:121).

Gate rows: chg_ledger_rows (lib/loopctl/changes/ledger_row.ex:21-32); kind gate is the full-suite verdict and raw['failures'] lists failing tests (chg cli/src/shadow.rs:105); exclude raw source hook exactly as LedgerRow.failing_test_gates/1 does (ledger_row.ex:48-58). Query bounded to the source repo, at > issue opened_at, newest 50.

Edges and verdicts: add {:detected, :failed, :recheck_duplicate} and {:detected, :done, :recheck_stale} to @transitions (stage_machine.ex:286), control-only like :recheck_fixed; @resolution_verdicts (:708) and Resolution (resolution.ex:65-128) gain :duplicate and :no_longer_reproduces under the existing not-actionable label.
Why failed for a duplicate and done for stale: a duplicate's work lives on in the other story; a stale report needed no work, the same terminal as already_fixed (US-52.36).
Base containment calls go through PullRequestSource.contains?/3 (pull_request_source.ex:274), at most 3 per story, and a forge error is US-52.36's forge_unavailable.
non_goals: Comparing issue text for similarity: reporter text is untrusted and never decides a close.
Merging duplicate threads or moving comments between issues.

failure_modes.partition: AC-52.37.3: base containment that cannot be established is not a pass row; with fewer than 3 the story proceeds to triage.
failure_modes.state: AC-52.37.6: every finding is recorded in the append-only 'rechecked' event, so what the re-check knew is kept with the decision.
failure_modes.retry: AC-52.37.7: locks in story id order and a re-read under the lock make concurrent re-checks close at most one of two duplicates; US-52.36's guard makes a repeated pass a no-op.
failure_modes.slow: AC-52.37.3: ledger rows are read bounded (newest 50) and containment is checked for at most 3 shas per story.
failure_modes.reach: n/a: runs inside US-52.36's re-check step in the existing TriageDispatchWorker cron.

definition_of_done: On production, a second sandbox issue carrying the same ticket_id as a live one is closed as a duplicate within five minutes with evidence linking the first.
SELECT edge, count(*) FROM story_stage_events WHERE edge IN ('recheck_duplicate','recheck_stale') GROUP BY edge runs, and each such event has a closure row with evidence.
defaults: Stale needs 3 full-suite gate passes on base since the report, with no later failure of a named test (owner may change).
The newer story is the duplicate; the older one keeps the work.
duplicate and no_longer_reproduces use the existing not-actionable label with their own text.
